title: When a save fails on the member page, Visits, Enquiries, Challenges or door machines, MettleUp is never told
what: When giving a challenge winner free days, saving a member's door machine number, a measurement, gym timings, a check-in, a cancel, an enquiry change or an expense removal fails, the owner sees a red line and a Try again. The reason is written only to that browser's hidden log, and on the member page, Visits, Enquiries and Expenses it is not written anywhere at all. The automatic crash reports catch only errors nobody handled, so none of these reach MettleUp. A gym where door numbers or challenge prizes keep failing would be the first to know.
expected: Every failed save the owner sees is also counted for MettleUp, with which screen and the reason, without any member details.
fix_line: Send a short no-personal-data report for each failed save the owner sees, the same way crashes are sent

title: If a server part goes missing, Challenges, Diet plans, Measurements and Gym timings calmly say it is not switched on yet, and nobody is told
what: These screens treat the gym server answering 'no such step' as 'this feature is not switched on for your gym yet' and show a calm empty card. That made sense while the server parts were being rolled out, but all four are live now. If a database change were undone or renamed by mistake, every gym would lose these screens with a polite message, nothing would be written even to the browser log, and MettleUp would hear only when an owner asks where their challenges went.
expected: For a live feature, a missing server part is treated as a fault: reported to MettleUp at once and shown to the owner as a problem being fixed.
how_often: only after a bad server change
fix_line: Report a missing server step for live features and stop calling it not switched on

title: On a slow line, saving a new diet plan again after an error can make two copies
what: A new diet plan is sent without any mark that says 'this is the same save'. If the plan reached the server but the answer was lost, the sheet shows an error and stays open. Pressing Save again makes a second plan with the same name, and if it was set to go to members, they may get both. Expenses and enquiries already carry such a mark; diet plans do not.
expected: A second press of Save after a lost answer saves the plan once.
how_often: rare: only when an answer is lost
fix_line: Give each new-plan sheet one save id and let the server ignore a repeat

title: A help question sent again after a lost answer reaches MettleUp twice and is paid twice
what: On Help and feedback, if the question reached MettleUp but the answer was lost, the owner sees 'could not send' with the text still there. Sending again makes a brand-new question, so MettleUp gets it twice, the AI answers twice from the gym's credits, and 'Your questions' shows one failed and one answered copy.
expected: Sending the same question again after a lost answer is recognised as the same question.
how_often: rare: only when an answer is lost
fix_line: Keep the same question key when the owner sends the same words again

items.reason: A web page: heart rate, watch and screen-off states do not apply. The only running clock is the door-machine list re-reading every 30 seconds, which resumes when the tab is shown again; a long import yields between batches and leaves unsent rows waiting with Try again.
